quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

activation.condition: Vehicle is in a marked passenger curb loading zone during hours when applicable regulations are effective.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park for any purpose or period except expeditious passenger loading or unloading.

exceptions.trigger: Actual expeditious passenger loading or unloading
exceptions.effect: Limited exception to stop, stand or park prohibition
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Use only the time needed for expeditious passenger loading or unloading
exceptions.source_clause: except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers

timing.description: Observe original effective-hours condition and actual in-zone halt and passenger event history.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: expeditious loading or unloading of passengers
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original event and halt history needs independent temporal review; no numeric legal cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: place marked as a passenger curb loading zone
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original marking, curb polygon, designation and vehicle pose require source and visibility review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original jurisdiction-specific regulation and synchronized civil clock are required.

parameter_refs.name: release_delay_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 1 or 12 second engineering probes, not legal cutoffs

parameter_refs.name: regulations_effective
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: true or false from original authority and clock

parameter_refs.name: zone_boundary_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: -0.5 to 0.5 m engineering pose requests from reviewed marked boundary

parameter_refs.name: civil_clock_offset_min
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: -30 to 30 min engineering clock requests relative to sourced boundary
